zh.config.apiKey.label: API Key
zh.config.apiKey.tooltip: Obsidian Local REST API 的鉴权令牌。在 Obsidian 设置 → Local REST API 中查看。
zh.config.scheme.label: 协议
zh.config.scheme.tooltip: 默认 https（端口 27124，自签名证书）。若无法信任证书，可在 Obsidian 中开启 HTTP 端点并改用 http（端口 27123）。
zh.config.host.label: 主机
zh.config.port.label: 端口
zh.config.rejectUnauthorized.label: 校验 TLS 证书
zh.config.rejectUnauthorized.tooltip: 默认关闭。Obsidian 默认使用自签名证书；除非已信任其证书，否则保持关闭。
zh.config.timeout.label: 超时(ms)
zh.config.timeout.tooltip: 单次请求超时时间（毫秒）。
zh.field.path.label: 文件路径
zh.field.path.list.tooltip: 要列出的 Vault 目录，如 "notes/"。留空表示 Vault 根目录。
zh.field.path.write.tooltip: Vault 内的文件路径。不存在的目录会自动创建。
zh.field.path.delete.tooltip: 要删除的 Vault 文件路径。
zh.field.path.open.tooltip: 要在 Obsidian 中打开的 Vault 文件路径。
zh.field.content.label: 内容
zh.field.content.patch.tooltip: 替换 frontmatter 字段时，contentType 选 application/json 并传入 JSON 值，如 "done"。
zh.field.targetType.label: 目标类型
zh.field.targetType.read.tooltip: 只读取某个 heading/block/frontmatter 字段。留空读取整个文件。
zh.field.targetType.write.tooltip: 同时设置 target 时，仅替换该 section（PUT 行为）。
zh.field.targetType.append.tooltip: 同时设置 target 时，内容追加到该 section 内（POST 行为）。
zh.field.target.label: 目标
zh.field.target.read.tooltip: 标题名、块引用 id 或 frontmatter key。嵌套标题用 "::" 分隔，如 "Work::Meetings"。
zh.field.target.write.tooltip: 标题名、块引用 id 或 frontmatter key。
zh.field.target.patch.tooltip: 标题名、块引用 id 或 frontmatter key。
zh.field.operation.label: 操作
zh.field.operation.tooltip: append = 在 section 之后添加，prepend = 在之前添加，replace = 覆盖该 section。
zh.field.contentType.label: Content-Type
zh.field.contentType.tooltip: 替换 frontmatter 字段为有类型 JSON 值时使用 application/json。
zh.field.query.label: 查询文本
zh.field.contextLength.label: 上下文长度
zh.field.contextLength.tooltip: 每个匹配周围上下文片段的长度。
zh.field.jsonLogic.label: JsonLogic 查询
zh.field.commandId.label: 命令 ID
zh.field.commandId.tooltip: Obsidian 命令 id，如 "app:toggle-left-sidebar"。可用「列出命令」查看所有 id。
zh.action.status.label: Obsidian 状态
zh.action.status.description: 检查 Obsidian Local REST API 服务是否运行、API Key 是否有效。
zh.action.vaultList.label: Obsidian 列出文件
zh.action.vaultList.description: 列出 Vault 目录下的文件和子目录。路径留空表示 Vault 根目录。
zh.action.vaultRead.label: Obsidian 读取笔记
zh.action.vaultRead.description: 读取 Vault 中的笔记或文件。可只读取某个 heading、块引用或 frontmatter 字段。
zh.action.vaultWrite.label: Obsidian 写入笔记
zh.action.vaultWrite.description: 创建或覆盖 Vault 文件。默认覆盖整个文件；设置目标时仅替换该 section。
zh.action.vaultAppend.label: Obsidian 追加笔记
zh.action.vaultAppend.description: 向笔记追加内容。默认追加到文件末尾；设置目标时追加到指定 heading/块内。
zh.action.vaultPatch.label: Obsidian 补丁笔记
zh.action.vaultPatch.description: 精细补丁某个 section：对 heading、块引用或 frontmatter 字段执行 append/prepend/replace，不影响文件其余部分。
zh.action.vaultDelete.label: Obsidian 删除笔记
zh.action.vaultDelete.description: 从 Vault 中删除文件。
zh.action.searchSimple.label: Obsidian 搜索
zh.action.searchSimple.description: 使用 Obsidian 内置模糊搜索进行全库全文检索，返回匹配文件名及带评分的上下文片段。
zh.action.searchQuery.label: Obsidian JsonLogic 搜索
zh.action.searchQuery.description: 通过 JsonLogic 对笔记元数据（frontmatter、tags、path、content）进行结构化搜索。
zh.action.commandList.label: Obsidian 列出命令
zh.action.commandList.description: 列出所有已注册的 Obsidian 命令（与命令面板一致）。
zh.action.commandExecute.label: Obsidian 执行命令
zh.action.commandExecute.description: 按 id 执行 Obsidian 命令，等同于从命令面板触发。
zh.action.tagsList.label: Obsidian 列出标签
zh.action.tagsList.description: 列出 Vault 中所有标签及其使用次数。
zh.action.openFile.label: Obsidian 打开文件
zh.action.openFile.description: 在 Obsidian UI 中打开笔记。
zh.action.activeFile.label: Obsidian 活动文件
zh.action.activeFile.description: 获取 Obsidian 中当前打开的笔记路径。

en.config.apiKey.label: API Key
en.config.apiKey.tooltip: Obsidian Local REST API key. Find it under Obsidian Settings → Local REST API.
en.config.scheme.label: Scheme
en.config.scheme.tooltip: Default https (port 27124, self-signed cert). If you cannot trust the cert, enable the HTTP server in Obsidian and use http (port 27123).
en.config.host.label: Host
en.config.port.label: Port
en.config.rejectUnauthorized.label: Verify TLS Cert
en.config.rejectUnauthorized.tooltip: Off by default. Obsidian uses a self-signed cert; keep this off unless you have trusted the certificate.
en.config.timeout.label: Timeout (ms)
en.field.path.label: File Path
en.field.path.list.tooltip: Vault directory to list, e.g. "notes/". Empty for vault root.
en.field.path.read.tooltip: Vault path of the file, e.g. "notes/idea.md".
en.field.path.write.tooltip: Vault path of the file. Non-existent directories are created automatically.
en.field.path.delete.tooltip: Vault path of the file to delete.
en.field.path.open.tooltip: Vault path of the file to open in Obsidian.
en.field.content.label: Content
en.field.content.write.tooltip: Plain text content of the note.
en.field.content.patch.tooltip: For frontmatter replace, set contentType=application/json and pass a JSON value, e.g. "done".
en.field.targetType.label: Target Type
en.field.targetType.read.tooltip: Read only a specific heading/block/frontmatter field. Leave empty to read the whole file.
en.field.targetType.write.tooltip: When set with a target, only that section is replaced (PUT behavior).
en.field.targetType.append.tooltip: When set with a target, content is appended inside that section (POST behavior).
en.field.target.label: Target
en.field.target.read.tooltip: Heading name, block reference id, or frontmatter key. Nested headings use "::" e.g. "Work::Meetings".
en.field.target.write.tooltip: Heading name, block reference id, or frontmatter key.
en.field.target.append.tooltip: Heading name or block reference id.
en.field.target.patch.tooltip: Heading name, block reference id, or frontmatter key.
en.field.operation.label: Operation
en.field.operation.tooltip: append = add after the section, prepend = add before, replace = overwrite the section.
en.field.contentType.label: Content-Type
en.field.contentType.tooltip: Use application/json when replacing a frontmatter field with a typed JSON value.
en.field.query.label: Query
en.field.contextLength.label: Context Length
en.field.contextLength.tooltip: Length of the context snippet around each match.
en.field.jsonLogic.label: JsonLogic Query
en.field.commandId.label: Command ID
en.field.commandId.tooltip: Obsidian command id, e.g. "app:toggle-left-sidebar". Use "List Commands" to discover ids.
en.action.status.label: Obsidian Status
en.action.status.description: Check whether the Obsidian Local REST API server is running and the API key is valid.
en.action.vaultList.label: Obsidian List Files
en.action.vaultList.description: List files and subdirectories inside a vault directory. Leave path empty to list the vault root.
en.action.vaultRead.label: Obsidian Read Note
en.action.vaultRead.description: Read a note or file from the vault. Optionally read only a specific heading, block reference, or frontmatter field.
en.action.vaultWrite.label: Obsidian Write Note
en.action.vaultWrite.description: Create or overwrite a vault file. Overwrites the whole file by default; with a target, replaces only that section.
en.action.vaultAppend.label: Obsidian Append Note
en.action.vaultAppend.description: Append content to a note. Defaults to appending to the end of the file; with a target, appends inside a specific heading/block.
en.action.vaultPatch.label: Obsidian Patch Note
en.action.vaultPatch.description: Surgically patch a specific section: append, prepend, or replace a heading, block reference, or frontmatter field without touching the rest of the file.
en.action.vaultDelete.label: Obsidian Delete Note
en.action.vaultDelete.description: Delete a file from the vault.
en.action.searchSimple.label: Obsidian Search
en.action.searchSimple.description: Full-text search across the whole vault using Obsidian's built-in fuzzy search. Returns matching filenames with scored context snippets.
en.action.searchQuery.label: Obsidian JsonLogic Search
en.action.searchQuery.description: Structured search via JsonLogic against note metadata (frontmatter, tags, path, content).
en.action.commandList.label: Obsidian List Commands
en.action.commandList.description: List all registered Obsidian commands (the same list shown in the command palette).
en.action.commandExecute.label: Obsidian Execute Command
en.action.commandExecute.description: Execute an Obsidian command by its id, as if triggered from the command palette.
en.action.tagsList.label: Obsidian List Tags
en.action.tagsList.description: List all tags used across the vault, with usage counts.
en.action.openFile.label: Obsidian Open File
en.action.openFile.description: Open a note in the Obsidian UI.
en.action.activeFile.label: Obsidian Active File
en.action.activeFile.description: Get the vault path of the note currently open in Obsidian.
